source: TallyPrime 1.1.7.2 (installed), menu tree + masters + voucher types + platform

features.name: Group
features.note: create, alter, delete; nature follows parent

features.name: Ledger
features.note: name, group, opening, GSTIN/state, PAN, mailing name/address/PIN/country/phone/e-mail, bill-wise, credit period, opening bills, cost centres, interest

features.name: Voucher Type
features.note: Own voucher types under a predefined one: automatic numbering with prefix/suffix/width/start and {FY}, yearly restart, or typed by hand (unique); print title; in use; F10 lists them; numbers shown everywhere and in GSTR-1 (documents issued per series)

features.name: Currency
features.note: symbol, formal name, decimal places, decimal word; rates of exchange by date (standard, selling, buying)

features.name: Cost Category
features.note: categories (Primary Cost Category predefined); Create/Alter A

features.name: Cost Centre
features.note: a tree of centres under a category; Create/Alter C; split on voucher lines via the Cost Allocations panel (accounting vouchers; not yet on item invoices)

features.name: Budget
features.note: groups, ledgers and cost centres; nett or closing; nested budgets; Budget Variance (also under a scenario)

features.name: Scenario
features.note: actuals or not plus reversing journals, optional and memorandum vouchers; TB, P&L, Balance Sheet under a scenario

features.name: GST Registration (Tax Unit)
features.note: main GSTIN plus further registrations; voucher types belong to one; GSTR-1/3B and the GSTR-1 file per registration

features.name: GST Classification
features.note: HSN/SAC, rate and taxability picked on items and ledgers; rate change reaches new invoices only; Edit Log

features.name: TDS Nature of Payment
features.note: section, rates (individual, others, no PAN), single and annual limits, 194Q excess; standard 2025-26 natures seeded

features.name: Stock Item
features.note: group, unit, opening qty/rate/value by godown; Alt+C from an invoice; Tally XML STOCKITEM

features.name: Unit
features.note: simple units with decimal places; compound units (Box of 12 Nos), entered as 2-5 and shown as 2 Box 5 Nos; rates are per the second unit

features.name: Stock Group
features.note: nested groups; Tally XML STOCKGROUP

features.name: Godown / Location
features.note: nested godowns, Main Location default; Tally XML GODOWN

features.name: Stock Category
features.note: Stock categories (tree), on stock items; backup and restore

features.name: Employee
features.note: cost centre with joining/leaving, designation, bank, PAN, UAN, PF, ESI IP, PRAN, tax regime

features.name: Employee Group
features.note: cost centre tree of employee groups; salary details by group

features.name: Employee Category
features.note: cost categories, as in Tally

features.name: Pay Head
features.note: ledger + calculation: user value, flat, attendance, production, computed with slabs/ceiling; statutory PF/EPS/EPF/EDLI/ESI/PT/IT/NPS; rounding

features.name: Attendance / Production Type
features.note: attendance, leave with pay, leave without pay, production with units

features.name: Closing stock (accounts-only)
features.note: stock valuation by date

features.name: Contra
features.note: accounting mode

features.name: Payment
features.note: accounting mode

features.note: accounting mode

features.note: accounting mode

features.note: accounting mode

features.note: accounting mode

features.name: Debit Note
features.note: accounting mode

features.name: Sales/Purchase in item-invoice mode
features.note: party, sales/purchase ledger, item lines with godown/qty/rate, additional ledgers, party bill-wise; Ctrl+V toggles; Tally XML ALLINVENTORYENTRIES

features.name: Memorandum
features.note: Ctrl+F10; kept with its lines but out of the books

features.name: Reversing Journal
features.note: out of the books, applicable-upto date, effective in scenarios until then

features.name: Post-dated vouchers
features.note: held out of the books until their date, then posted by the server on the day; listed with what they will move

features.name: Optional vouchers
features.note: Ctrl+L or the Optional button; out of the books until made regular, which posts it

features.name: Sales Order
features.note: Alt+F5; party, items, rate, due date per line; pending until delivered or invoiced

features.name: Purchase Order
features.note: via F10 (Tally's Alt+F4 would close the window); same as Sales Order

features.name: Delivery Note
features.note: Alt+F8; made against a pending Sales Order (fills its lines); moves stock, invoiced later without moving it again

features.name: Receipt Note
features.note: Alt+F9; against a Purchase Order; values stock at its rate; the purchase invoiced against it does not count the goods twice

features.name: Stock Journal
features.note: Alt+F7; Source and Destination lists, godown transfers and manufacture; one product takes the materials' cost

features.name: Physical Stock
features.note: Ctrl+F7; counted quantity per item and godown; the difference (fixed when saved, worked out again on alteration) goes in or out at average cost

features.name: Manufacturing Journal
features.note: BOM fill (Alt+B), components at average cost, production takes cost + additional cost

features.name: Rejections In
features.note: goods rejected by a customer back into stock, with party

features.name: Rejections Out
features.note: goods returned to a supplier, with party

features.name: Material In
features.note: receives finished goods against a Job Work Out Order and consumes materials at the job worker; principal materials into third-party godown

features.name: Material Out
features.note: sends materials to the job worker's godown at cost; or back to a principal

features.name: Job Work In Order
features.note: principal's order: goods to send back, pending tracked

features.name: Job Work Out Order
features.note: order to a job worker, pending tracked by Material In

features.name: Payroll
features.note: Payroll voucher with Ctrl+F Auto Fill, entries split by employee

features.name: Attendance
features.note: Attendance voucher, no ledger entries

features.name: Drill-down from reports to vouchers
features.note: TB, Balance Sheet and P&L -> group summary -> ledger -> statement -> voucher; arrows down the left side, then the right

features.name: Stock Summary
features.note: average cost; group drill; Alt+F1 detailed with godown quantities; feeds P&L and Balance Sheet

features.name: Ratio Analysis
features.note: Principal groups and ratios as Tally lists them (current, quick, debt/equity, GP/NP %, operating cost, receivable days, ROI, return on working capital)

features.name: Cash Flow
features.note: Month-wise inflow/outflow of cash and bank; a month opens the groups the money came from or went to; Contra is not a flow

features.name: Funds Flow
features.note: Sources and applications of funds with working capital changes by group; sources less applications = the change in working capital

features.name: Income & Expense A/c
features.note: F11 switch: one Income & Expenditure account with the excess of income over expenditure

features.name: Dashboard
features.note: figures tiles, sales/purchases by month, largest receivables and payables, drill-down

features.name: Statistics
features.note: vouchers by type (own types, cancelled, optional) and masters by kind; Enter opens the register

features.name: Ledger (vouchers with running balance)

features.name: Cash/Bank Books

features.name: Interest Payable
features.note: as receivable, for Cr results

features.name: Ledger interest
features.note: rate % a year on the balance or on overdue bills (from the due date, as bills settle); stretch-by-stretch calculation; not booked as vouchers, one rate for the whole period

features.name: Group interest

features.name: Cost Centre Summary
features.note: Category Summary: each category with its centres, sub-centres rolled into their parent

features.name: Group Break-up

features.name: Bank Reconciliation

features.name: Bank Statement import

features.name: Cheque Printing

features.name: Cheque Register
features.note: every cheque issued and received, by bank, with cleared / not cleared / post-dated status

features.name: Post-dated cheque summary

features.name: Deposit Slip

features.name: Payment Advice
features.note: letter to the payee with the cheque and the bills it settles

features.name: Stock Item vouchers
features.note: running quantity, drill to the invoice

features.name: Godown Summary

features.name: Stock Group Summary
features.note: Stock Summary for one stock group

features.name: Stock Query
features.note: One item: group, category, HSN/rate, closing stock and value, average cost, stock by godown, last 5 purchases and sales, on order, reorder level

features.name: Ageing Analysis
features.note: FIFO ageing of the stock in hand by receipt date, brackets 0-45/45-90/90-180/180+ or ?brackets=; godown transfers do not reset age

features.name: Reorder Status
features.note: Reorder level and minimum order on the stock item (migration 021, XML REORDERBASE/MINIMUMORDERBASE); purchase orders pending and sales orders due counted

features.name: Stock Category Summary
features.note: Items by category across stock groups, drill into sub-categories; uncategorised items listed by themselves

features.name: Batch/Godown vouchers
features.note: batch per line with mfg/expiry, stock checked per batch and godown, opening batch, batch-wise expiry report

features.name: Movement Analysis
features.note: Inward and outward quantity, value and average rate per item, and per party for one item; orders and godown transfers excluded

features.name: Cost Estimation
features.note: BOM explosion at average cost, multi-level

features.name: Item Cost Track
features.note: cost track on vouchers and invoices; sales, costs, margin, goods in/out per track

features.name: Sales Order analysis
features.note: monthly ordered value and quantity by item or party, delivered and pending (plus outstandings)

features.name: Purchase Order analysis
features.note: as for sales orders

features.name: Order/note registers
features.note: Sales/Purchase Order Books, Delivery/Receipt Note, Stock Journal and Physical Stock Registers

features.name: Job work reports
features.note: orders out/in pending, our stock with job workers (valued), principals stock with us

features.name: GSTR-1
features.note: B2B, B2C Large/Small, exports (with/without payment), credit notes registered and unregistered, nil, HSN B2B/B2C, documents, amendments (B2BA, B2CLA, CDNRA) once a month is marked filed, needs-attention list, portal JSON (Alt+J); JSON not yet checked against the offline tool

features.name: GSTR-3B
features.note: 3.1(a)(b)(c)(d), 3.2, 4(A)(3)(5), 4(B)(2), 4(C), 4(D)(1), payment with Rule 88A set-off; reverse charge tax in cash; no interest or late fee

features.name: GST on vouchers (CGST/SGST/IGST)
features.note: CGST+SGST or IGST from the place of supply, filled into invoices; breakup stored with each voucher; wrong tax flagged

features.name: e-Invoice (IRN)
features.note: IRP schema 1.1 JSON per voucher and in bulk (Alt+J), with every portal check before upload; IRN, ack and signed QR stored and printed with the QR code. Direct generation through a GSP/NIC API needs credentials

features.name: e-Way Bill
features.note: Bulk-upload JSON (Alt+W) with transport Part B, direction for sales/purchase/returns; e-Way Bill number and validity stored and printed. Direct generation needs credentials

features.name: GSTR-9 annual
features.note: tables 4, 5, 6-8 (8A from 2B as accepted in IMS), 9, 17, 18 from GSTR-1 and twelve GSTR-3Bs

features.name: GSTR-2A/2B reconciliation
features.note: GSTR-2B JSON upload; matched / mismatch (date, value, tax) / not in books / not in 2B, on supplier invoice no.

features.name: GSTR-1 reconciliation
features.note: filed GSTR-1 JSON against the books (B2B, CDNR)

features.name: Challan reconciliation
features.note: GST payments by tax with CPIN/CIN/date, against GSTR-3B cash

features.name: Reverse charge
features.note: reverse-charge purchase/expense ledgers (invoice, journal or payment): 3.1(d) and 4(A)(3), paid in cash

features.name: Advances received/paid
features.note: advances for services (rate on receipt, Advance bill), 11A unadjusted, 11B adjusted; net in GSTR-3B 3.1(a)

features.name: GST rate setup
features.note: rate and HSN/SAC on stock items and on service/other ledgers

features.name: Party GSTIN update

features.name: CMP-08

features.name: GSTR-4
features.note: inward 4A-4C, CMP-08 of the year, outward at the composition rate

features.name: IMS inward
features.note: accept / reject / pending per 2B document, kept across uploads; credit of documents not rejected

features.name: Kerala flood cess
features.note: report of the 1% (0.25%) cess on Kerala intra-state B2C supplies, Aug 2019 to Jul 2021

features.name: UQC setup

features.name: TDS on vouchers
features.note: natures of payment (standard 194C/J/I/H/A/Q, editable), deductee types, PAN/206AA, single and annual limits with catch-up, 194Q excess; hint and Alt+T on vouchers

features.name: Periods and year-end carry forward
features.note: P&L carried into Profit & Loss A/c

features.name: Double-entry enforced by the engine
features.note: commit-time check in the database

features.name: XML integration (import/export)
features.note: masters and vouchers in; TB, accounts, Day Book, Balance Sheet, P&L, Stock Summary, Ledger Vouchers, Bills Receivable/Payable out

features.name: Print / PDF
features.note: Alt+P prints any screen (Save as PDF in the dialog); printable vouchers with amount in words

features.name: Export to Excel/PDF
features.note: Alt+E writes a native .xlsx (numbers as numbers, #,##0.00, bold headings and totals); Alt+P prints or saves PDF

features.name: Email documents
features.note: Alt+M on any screen: the screen as HTML (styles inlined) through the company SMTP server; settings with write-only password, test send, E-mail Log

features.name: Users, passwords and roles
features.note: Owner, Accountant, Data Entry, Viewer enforced by the server; scrypt passwords; sessions; Edit Log names the user; no custom security levels yet

features.name: Backup and restore
features.note: one-file company backup; restore re-checks every rule; Edit Log travels with it

features.name: Multi-user over network (server mode)
features.note: HOST=0.0.0.0 with sign-in and roles, HTTPS with TLS_CERT/TLS_KEY

features.name: ODBC access
features.note: read-only odbc schema views over the PostgreSQL ODBC driver (server edition)

features.name: Data import from Excel
features.note: ledgers, stock items, vouchers from .xlsx/.csv with loose column names; template; failed rows reported

features.name: Split company data
features.note: two new companies at a date; closing balances, pending bills and stock carried as opening

features.name: Multi-currency
features.note: ledgers in a currency, forex amount @ rate on vouchers and item invoices, bills keep forex, statement in the currency, Forex Gain/Loss (realised/unrealised by bill) with an adjusting Journal; not in XML vouchers

features.name: Multiple companies consolidated (group company)
features.note: consolidated BS, P&L and TB of member companies by group and ledger name

features.name: Remote access / Tally.NET sync
features.note: the server edition is reachable from anywhere when hosted with HTTPS and sign-in; no Tally.NET-style relay or account login

features.name: Language / transliteration

features.name: Bill-wise settlement in vouchers
features.note: New Ref / Agst Ref / Advance / On Account; opening bills; Tally XML BILLALLOCATIONS

features.name: Company features on/off (F11)
features.note: F11 / Alt+K Features: inventory, godowns, orders, stock categories, bill-wise, cost centres, interest, GST, cheques, optional vouchers, e-documents, e-mail; switching off hides menus and voucher types, never deletes data

features.name: Configurations (F12)
features.note: new voucher date, current balances, negative cash/bank warning, Day Book narrations
